## Resuming stale `in_progress` ticket (prior session died; no live holder)

Confirmed before touching anything: this ticket is `in_progress` with `claimed_session=null`,
`claim_harness=null`, `claim_remote_session=null`, assigned to `joeoakhart@navapbc.com`. No live
session holds it, so per the stale-claim carve-out I am resuming it in place rather than issuing a
fresh `claim` (which only moves open→in_progress and would error on an already-in_progress ticket).
Re-verification of the proven root cause on **current `origin/main`** follows in the next comment.
